anki.label: Decks with due cards (initial example)
anki.expected: 5 cards ready; selectable due deck rows. Zero-due rows are quiet.

anki.label: One deck has zero due while others remain
anki.expected: Show check in completed row, preserve available deck rows; do not show global success.

anki.label: Every listed deck has zero due
anki.expected: Small top positive banner and all decks marked clear; no universal Start button.

anki.label: Loading initial deck data
anki.expected: Neutral stable skeletons; do not show zero due.

anki.label: Background resync with cache
anki.expected: Show cached rows and small sync indicator; disable only risky actions.

anki.label: Offline with previously synced deck data
anki.expected: Explain data may be stale; deck action only if native integration permits it.

anki.label: Offline with no data
anki.expected: Reason and Retry; do not falsely mark complete.

anki.label: AnkiDroid permission, integration or read failure
anki.expected: Action to grant permission/retry; preserve known data if possible.

anki.label: Anki reachable but no decks
anki.expected: Simple no-decks state; separate from queue completion.

anki.label: Just finished a deck, then returned
anki.expected: Momentarily acknowledge finished deck (if supported), then persist zero-due row.

wanikani.label: Both queues have items
wanikani.expected: Two vertically stacked borderless sections with black CTAs.

wanikani.label: No reviews due, lessons available
wanikani.expected: Reviews: clear state, next review if known; Lessons: still actionable.

wanikani.label: Reviews available, no lessons due
wanikani.expected: Reviews: actionable; Lessons: check + no batch, no CTA.

wanikani.label: Reviews and lessons both zero
wanikani.expected: Both sections persist; subtle global acknowledgment, no Start CTAs.

wanikani.label: Refresh with cached counts
wanikani.expected: Cached content with sync affordance, no double requests.

wanikani.label: Network offline, cached queues known
wanikani.expected: State as last synced; action policy based on actual offline capability.

wanikani.label: Offline, no cached queues
wanikani.expected: Show offline and Retry; no zeros.

wanikani.label: Unauthorized, rate-limit, server error
wanikani.expected: Appropriate retry or reconnect instructions; no fake completion.

wanikani.label: Lesson entitlement restricts new lessons
wanikani.expected: Reviews may continue; lessons show locked or unavailable as returned by API.

wanikani.label: Returning after queue completion
wanikani.expected: Refresh queue first; show acknowledgment only when proven, not automatically from session count.
